findings.evidence: Lines 5 and 72 use 'fiscal year'; lines 11, 14, 47 use 'benefit year'. Line 72 repeats lines 5-6 verbatim in Questions and Updates section. The document never clarifies whether these terms refer to the same period or distinct concepts.
findings.fix: Choose one term and use it consistently throughout, or define both terms and their relationship if they differ.
findings.location: Program Overview (lines 5), Eligibility (lines 11, 14, 47), Questions and Updates (line 72)
findings.violation: Two terms for what appears to be the same concept (annual periods) are used interchangeably without explanation of their difference or equivalence.
